answer: In an agent marketplace routing walnut shipments through a wharf, each bidding identity must lock $100 in escrow for 30 days before its bids count as a demand signal. The deposit cannot back two identities at once, and closing an account does not release it early. An attacker can still invent names, but making 10,000 of them active requires immobilizing $1 million, so fake identities are no longer free.
